thread:
zoe-release: canary in eu-central went live at 09:05. deploybot just fired an alert for a small error uptick on /v1/generate. keeping small blast fixes top of mind.
pat-sre: can you paste the deploybot payload? duration and which metric?
deploybot: DeployBot: Canary alert: error_rate = 0.95% (threshold 0.6%), latency_p95 = +45ms (threshold 50ms), duration = 5m. Auto-rollback = SUPPRESSED (combined ambiguous signal). Suggested actions: reduce slice OR toggle feature flag OR pin previous model.
dena-ops: reducing canary slice to 3% now: `trafficctl set-slice --route gen-api --slice 3%`. action id = 9c3d2a.
li-engineering: quick triage: new memory allocation tweak in runtime might cause sporadic GC pauses; flipping `runtime.gc.tune=off` in canary reduced repro locally. recommend flag toggle first.
zoe-release: agree, try flag toggle + reduce slice. if error_rate stays >0.8% for 8m we pin to v2.2.8. I will approve the pin if needed.
pat-sre: executing flag toggle on canary nodes: `runtime.gc.tune = false` for nodes tagged canary-6209. logging id=fa12b3.
deploybot: DeployBot: runtime flag updated for canary nodes (action fa12b3). monitoring telemetry.
pat-sre: metrics after toggle ~90s later: error_rate -> 0.55%, p95 -> +18ms. trending down.
sam-cs: support saw 1 internal ticket but no external public reports. drafting a short customer note in case we escalate.
zoe-release: good work. keep 10m watch. if stable we'll log as mitigated by feature-flag toggle and close with guidance for reverting the GC tweak in the build. If it regresses, I'll approve immediate pin and sam will post the customer-facing note.
li-engineering: will follow up with a patch to remove the aggressive GC tweak from the default profile.
pat-sre: standing by for escalation.
zoe-release: thanks team :thumbsup:
